data.long_meaning: The name Harlene is derived from the Hebrew words ‘har’, meaning ‘mountain’ or ‘rock’, and ‘el’, meaning ‘God’. This name signifies a strong and steadfast woman, one who is a dwelling place of God and a rock of support for others. The name Harlene carries the meaning “House of God's Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harlene usually hope their child will grow to embody house of god's rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
